name: A challenge with NO_REALM_BANK refuses to open the Realm Bank vault
contract: Hardcore (challenge 54) and 60 other challenges declare CHALLENGE_RULES_TYPE_NO_REALM_BANK, but no code enforced it: a challenger could summon the Realm Bank (item 1180097, spell 92078) and move items between the account's characters.
Expected: HandlePersonalBankActivate asks AscensionPersonalBank::CanAccess before opening a vault; the challenge guard refuses the Realm Bank kind while the rule is active and tells the player why.
Control: the same vault opens without the refusal before the challenge starts.
